labels.justification: The clause addresses the purpose of processing personal data, aligning with the requirement to inform Data Principals of the processing purpose.
The clause describes personal data collected, matching the requirement to inform Data Principals of the data and its purpose.
The clause addresses data security measures, aligning with the requirement to implement security safeguards like encryption and masking.
The clause outlines the lawful purpose of data processing, matching the requirement to process data only for a lawful purpose.
The clause addresses data sharing, aligning with the requirement to process data only for the specified purpose unless non-consent is indicated.
The clause outlines Data Principal rights, matching the requirement for Data Principals to request access to their personal data.
